"""Brute-force exact planner (independent). Slow; used for verification."""
import json, sys

def solve(req):
    caps = req['capacities']; flows = req['flows']
    warmup = req['warmup']; pinned = set(req['pinned']); offers = req['offers']
    n = len(flows)
    ben = []
    for f in flows:
        kinds = f['kinds']; tmpl = bytes.fromhex(f['template']); H = len(tmpl)
        nd = kinds.count('D'); N = len(f['path']); h = N - 1
        per = (H - 4 - nd) * N
        q = kinds.index('Q'); t = kinds.index('T')
        elig = 0; cum = 0
        for run in offers[f['id']]:
            hdr = bytes.fromhex(run['header'])
            good = all(kinds[i] != 'K' or hdr[i] == tmpl[i] for i in range(H)) \
                and hdr[q] <= 7 and hdr[t] > h
            if good:
                end = cum + run['count']
                if end > warmup:
                    elig += end - max(cum, warmup)
            cum += run['count']
        ben.append(per * elig)
    nodes = list(caps)
    nm = {}
    for nd in nodes:
        m = 0
        for i, f in enumerate(flows):
            if nd in f['path']:
                m |= 1 << i
        nm[nd] = m
    pinmask = 0
    for i, f in enumerate(flows):
        if f['id'] in pinned:
            pinmask |= 1 << i
    best = None
    for mask in range(1 << n):
        if (mask & pinmask) != pinmask:
            continue
        ok = True
        for nd in nodes:
            if (mask & nm[nd]).bit_count() > caps[nd]:
                ok = False; break
        if not ok:
            continue
        b = 0
        mm = mask
        while mm:
            b += ben[mm.bit_length() - 1]
            mm &= mm - 1
        key = (b, -mask.bit_count())
        if best is None or key > best[0]:
            best = (key, mask)
    mask = best[1]
    sel = sorted(flows[i]['id'] for i in range(n) if mask >> i & 1)
    return {'selected': sel, 'saved': sum(ben[i] for i in range(n) if mask >> i & 1)}

if __name__ == '__main__':
    for line in sys.stdin:
        sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(solve(json.loads(line)), separators=(',', ':')) + '\n')
PYEOF
